text:
Situation: Esmolol hydrochloride inventory is limited. Corvale East holds 214 units at 10.7 units per day, providing 20 days on hand. Corvale General holds 386 units at 13.9 units per day, providing 28 days on hand. The product label identifies Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC (FEI 3014288534) as the repackager.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspected the Medical Purchasing Solutions facility on 2024-09-11 and classified the inspection VAI. As of 2026-10-21, esmolol hydrochloride is not listed on the FDA drug shortage database.

Our position: Current supply covers approximately three to four weeks at both campuses. No FDA shortage listing exists. The repackager’s last inspection resulted in a VAI classification. Alternative manufacturers are available and not on the FDA shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Henry Schein, Inc. (Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited Hyderabad plant); requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if new NDC.
2. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if new NDC.
3. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Baxter Healthcare Company; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if new NDC.
4. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Baxter Healthcare Corporation; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if new NDC.
5. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Eugia US LLC; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition if new NDC.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or dose conservation measures at this time; inventory supports current usage.
